rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §1/§3/§9; flat LIGHT backgrounds; product cut out (white-bg Fossil images cut out cleanly); 1–3 words on screen; a detailed 2-D object in every shot; watermark below content; logo end card; audio LOCKED. Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s. Draw NO Marvel, Avengers, X-Men or Fossil logos/characters (text names only; logos appear only as printed on the official product photos). No movie footage, posters or trailer frames. Gambit spin always with pill 'Fossil says'.
official_clips: none (fossil.com product pages have stills only)
palette_for_this_video: paper main; sky for the numbers; blush for THE CATCH; mint for SPEC
new_objects: none required. Reuse: watchOutline, questionStamp, poster, calendar, counter, calipers, ruler, clockRing, priceTag, arrowPointer, scoreTable.

scenes.anchor: Fossil just made a watch… for Doctor Doom.
scenes.image: A cut out centred 80% width, slow push-in
scenes.object: watchOutline traces the case; small pill 'Fossil × Marvel' (text only)
scenes.note: frame 1 = poster A: Doom watch + '$325' huge

scenes.image: A, B, C, D cut out in a 2×2 grid, each pops in
scenes.object: poster card 'AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY · IN THEATERS DEC 18' (plain text, no Marvel logo drawn)

scenes.anchor: Four limited watches, and you can buy them today.
Get this. Doom, Thor, Gambit, and Mister Fantastic.
scenes.image: A→B→C→D quick cuts, each cut out 70% (0.6 s each)
scenes.object: nameplate pill per watch: 'DOCTOR DOOM' / 'THOR' / 'GAMBIT' / 'MR. FANTASTIC'
calipers close on the case, readout rolls to '44 mm'
calipers widen to '46 mm'; ruler under both cases for scale

scenes.anchor: Fossil says a flick of your wrist makes Gambit's dial spin!
scenes.bg: lavender (or paper if no lavender token)
scenes.image: C cut out 75%, small wrist-flick rotation (±8°)
scenes.object: clockRing spins around the dial with motion trail; pill 'Fossil says'
priceTag swings in, rolls 0→'$325'; small pill 'UK £329'

scenes.image: E (Doom caseback) 75% card, zoom on the numbering area
scenes.object: arrowPointer to the caseback numbering; label 'LIMITED EDITION'

scenes.anchor: but Fossil won't say how many.
scenes.object: counter spins wildly then lands on '???'; questionStamp

scenes.anchor: By our score? Sixty-eight out of a hundred.
scenes.image: none (graphic only) or A small corner

scenes.anchor: It's a spec. Grab one if you want Marvel on your wrist before the movie.
scenes.object: k snaps upright (SPEC end-card motion); calendar 'DEC 18' small; pill '✓ before the movie'

scenes.anchor: Be honest. Which hero would you wear?
scenes.image: A centred 80% exactly as frame 1, B/C/D peek in as small tiles
scenes.object: questionStamp; ends on the frame-1 layout
